Why it pays off

Less than one night's stay

A year of UbyHost costs 1,190 CZK, about what one night in your apartment earns. Reports, the guest book and the stay fee are off your plate.

Privacy first

Only what the law asks for. Nothing extra.

We store as little as we can, and say exactly what and for how long. Privacy policy

  1. 01

    Only the fields Czech law asks for

    The guest form asks for the guest-book and stay-fee details, plus an e-mail for the guest's private link.

  2. 02

    No tracking cookies

    Only the cookies that keep you signed in and protect your forms.

  3. 03

    No trackers in the app

    No ad or analytics scripts in the app or on guest pages. Website statistics run on public pages only, with PostHog Cloud EU.

  4. 04

    Passport photos deleted after check-in

    Optional and off by default. Deleted as soon as you verify the guest, otherwise automatically 7 days after check-in.

Common questions

Questions and answers

When does the trial start?

Your 30-day trial starts when you verify your email address and activate your account. You can connect UbyPort during the trial.

What counts as an apartment?

Every listing with its own calendar. Guests, stays and teammates are unlimited.

Do I need a card?

No. You pay by bank transfer on an invoice we send after the trial.

What if I add an apartment?

The price adjusts automatically and you pay only the remaining part. When you remove an apartment, the lower price applies from the next period.

Can I cancel anytime?

Yes. The service runs until the end of the paid period and you can download the guest book at any time.

Can I get an invoice for my company?

Yes, with your company ID and VAT ID. We fill in the details from the ARES register.

What if I pay late?

We send a reminder. Everything keeps running for 30 days after the due date, and we never stop reporting guests who are already registered.

How do I pay?

By bank transfer on the invoice: scan the QR code in your banking app. We match the payment ourselves. Card payments are coming soon.

What about eTurista?

It is not law yet and the state has not published its interface. Once it does, we connect to it and move your data over with no retyping.
